items.title: Experience the future of Media and Entertainment, Sports, and Advertising Technology at AWS re:Invent 2026
items.summary: The biggest week in cloud and AI is quickly approaching, with the Amazon Web Services (AWS) re:Invent conference set for November 30-December 4, 2026 in Las Vegas, NV. This year, attendees can experience how the cloud and AI are fundamentally transforming workloads in media and entertainment (M&E), advertising technology, sports, and more. Join more than […]
